authority.action_baseline: MV-IA-F006/F007 authoritative Action and combat resolution

identity_state_layers.name: Lineage / Subspecies / Species Variant
rules: same name, shared source document, or visual similarity cannot create a lineage relationship
variant relationships remain explicit and source-backed

identity_state_layers.name: Reusable Form / Alternate-Form Definition
rules: a Form Definition is not the same as a Character currently being in that form
temporary and permanent Forms remain distinguishable where source rules distinguish them

identity_state_layers.name: Biological Trait / Species Perk / Innate Ability Definition
rules: species eligibility does not prove a perk is physiological
mixed species/innate dataset membership does not prove biology ownership

identity_state_layers.name: Morphology / Body Plan / Anatomy
owns: size and body-plan facts where sourced
rules: appearance prose and biological mechanics remain distinguishable
source absence is not filled with human-default anatomy

identity_state_layers.name: Character Species / Form Selection and Grants
rules: selection never edits the reusable Definition
Character-authored identity remains separate from governed mechanical selection

identity_state_layers.name: Current Character Body / Form State
rules: current form is runtime/Character state, not source Definition truth
reconnect restores authoritative current form

identity_state_layers.name: Transformation / Adaptation State
rules: learned environment perks do not automatically become biological Adaptations
runtime transformation is executed by the owning Ability/Action workflow

identity_state_layers.name: Senses / Movement / Physiology
owns: speed or movement constraints where sourced
rules: unknown/source-unspecified is not normal-human default
current environment may constrain physiology without rewriting Species source facts

identity_state_layers.name: Biological Compatibility / Limits / Vulnerabilities
rules: compatibility requires explicit source/rule evidence
absence of an incompatibility rule is not universal compatibility

identity_state_layers.name: Bioengineering / Symbiosis / Biological Modification
rules: Kola-Ha Forms are not generic equipment
Asset/cybernetic semantics are inherited from PPIA-03 only when the source/rules actually model an Asset or installed object

identity_state_layers.name: Knowledge / Reveal / Visibility Projection
rules: authorization filters before search, counts, compare targets, warnings, exports, diagnostics, or AI context
unknown-to-Player is not false-in-source

identity_state_layers.name: Source / Provenance / History / Recovery
rules: history is append-only and role-filtered
ambiguous network outcomes use operation-status lookup before retry

source_guardrails: Raw PDF/CSV source provenance remains preserved; PPIA-05 does not rewrite source to make biology cleaner or more complete.
Culture, society, belief, philosophy, profession, history and learned behavior are not immutable biology unless the source explicitly states a biological mechanism.
A Species perk can be biological, learned, cultural, mystical, technological or mixed; species eligibility alone is insufficient to classify physiology.
Environment-based perks and abilities are not biological Adaptations without explicit Species/Form/innate/body evidence.
The 2,203-row species/elementalist/innate dataset contains 260 Species Perks, 539 Innate Abilities and 1,404 Elementalist rows; dataset membership is insufficient to establish biology ownership.
The 57 Shapeshifter pricing-only rows cannot be automatically merged with the 60 detailed Ability rows by name, tier, position or similarity.
Same-name, shared-document, appearance, species label or narrative similarity is insufficient to create lineage, Form, compatibility or identity relationships.
Source fact, source absence, inference/recommendation, Character selection, runtime form state, temporary Effect/Condition state and Campaign environment remain distinguishable.
permission_invariants: authorize before Species/Form existence, search, variant lists, body details, hidden forms, vulnerabilities, biological history, compare targets, provenance, exports, diagnostics, notifications or AI context
hidden or unrevealed forms, weaknesses, transformations and private Character biology contribute nothing to unauthorized counts, facets, compare results, failure text or AI context
GM authority is Campaign-scoped and does not imply unrelated user-private or other-Campaign Character biology access
AI/service projections are minimum necessary and cannot independently choose Species/Form, transform, reveal, mutate biology, approve bioengineering, or promote content
mutation_invariants: Species/Form Definition inspection never mutates source content
Character Species/Form selection stores stable references and grants but never rewrites the reusable Definition
runtime transformation or Adaptation changes current authorized state and history but never rewrites source Species/Form identity
temporary Effects, Conditions, equipment or Campaign environment never silently become permanent source biology
learned Species-gated perks never silently become anatomy or innate physiology
accepted transformation/Adaptation mutations are server-authoritative, expected-version checked and idempotent
offline authoritative Species/Form selection, transformation, Adaptation or bioengineering mutation is prohibited
accessibility_invariants: Species/Form selection and comparison are fully keyboard and touch operable
screen readers receive semantic layer labels, source/conflict state, prerequisites, active-form state and Adaptation compatibility
morphology, anatomy and appearance facts have textual equivalents and are never image-only
color, animation, silhouette, body diagram location or drag gestures are never the sole carrier of biological or transformation state
high zoom/reflow and reduced motion preserve selection, validation, transformation and recovery meaning
boundary: This taxonomy is an implementation-ready PPIA-05 foundation. It does not promote mixed ability rows, auto-pair Shapeshifter pricing records, convert culture into biology, invent source facts, implement application runtime, activate STAGE-A-A2, or authorize release/deployment/tester/paid/credential operations.
